description: This file contains a test fixture class for functional testing of a web application using ASP.NET Core. It customizes the application host to set up in-memory databases for testing purposes, replacing production database configurations.

classes.name: TestApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory used for functional testing, configuring the web host environment and replacing database services with in-memory databases for tests.

methods.name: CreateHost
methods.description: Overrides the CreateHost method to configure the ASP.NET Core host with specific environment and in-memory database services for testing.
